title: 7 ChatGPT prompts that save 10 hours a week
caption: Seven prompts that quietly replace an afternoon of work. Save this — you'll come back to it.

slides.headline: 7 ChatGPT prompts that quietly save you

slides.title: The inbox triager
slides.body: "Here are 20 unread emails (pasted below). Sort into: reply now, reply later, delegate, ignore. One-line reason each." Turns 40 minutes of inbox dread into 4.

slides.title: The meeting compressor
slides.body: "Here's a meeting transcript. Give me: decisions made, who owns what by when, and the one thing still unresolved." Never re-watch a recording again.

slides.title: The first-draft killer
slides.body: "Write the worst possible version of this in 5 bullets, then the best. I'll pick the parts I want." Beats staring at a blank page every time.

slides.title: The decision pressure-test
slides.body: "I'm leaning toward X. Argue the strongest case against it, then tell me what would have to be true for the opposite to win." Kills bad calls before they cost you.

slides.title: The learning accelerator
slides.body: "Explain [topic] at three levels: to a 10-year-old, to a smart adult, to an expert. Then quiz me on the middle one." A week of study in 20 minutes.

slides.title: The cold-message writer
slides.body: "Write 3 cold outreach versions to [person/role]: one curiosity-led, one value-led, one provocative. Under 60 words each." Pick, tweak, send.

slides.title: The weekly review partner
slides.body: "Here's everything I did this week (pasted). What did I avoid? What was busywork? What's the one lever I ignored?" The 10-minute habit that compounds.
